name: Satellite / aircraft trail removal
description: One click: detect straight satellite and aircraft trails (Radon candidates verified by a contrast scan statistic against trail-free lines), measure their width, add them to the shared mask (undoable in Mask > Edit Mask), flag catalogue objects touching a trail (TRAIL_FLAG), optionally interpolate the band from the local sky or write a mask extension for multi-frame stacks. The image is never modified.

params.name: threshold
params.label: Detection threshold
params.help: Significance of the best along-track run relative to parallel trail-free lines of the same image (robust z). the default was set from the false-trail rate on trail-free HUDF, M51 and synthetic galaxy fields (see docs/trails.md); lower = more sensitive to faint trails, more false detections.

params.name: min-length
params.label: Minimum length (px, 0 = auto)
params.help: Shortest trail accepted; 0 = 12 % of the image diagonal (at least 30 px). Lower it to find short partial trails.

params.name: max-trails
params.label: Maximum number of trails
params.help: Stop after this many trails per image.

params.name: smooth
params.label: Smoothing sigma (px)
params.help: Gaussian smoothing of the background-subtracted image before the line search (0 = none).

params.name: min-aspect
params.label: Minimum length / width
params.help: Reject candidates that are shorter than this many times their measured FWHM (chains of galaxies make broad, short ridges).

params.name: max-fwhm
params.label: Maximum width (px)
params.help: Reject candidates whose fitted FWHM exceeds this.

params.name: catalog-check
params.label: Use elongated catalogue objects as evidence
params.help: When a catalogue is loaded, candidates slightly below the threshold are accepted if at least two elongated (A/B>=3), aligned objects lie on them.

params.name: margin
params.label: Mask margin (px)
params.help: Added to the measured half-width (box half-width + edge-sigma x blur) of the trail profile.

params.name: edge-sigma
params.label: Profile edge (sigma)
params.help: Number of profile blur widths added outside the fitted box edge.

params.name: end-extend
params.label: Extend ends (px)
params.help: Extend each trail segment by this many pixels at both ends (a partial trail fades out gradually).

params.name: fill
params.label: Fill option
params.help: mask = leave the trail masked (default, for photometry); interpolate = additionally write <image>_trailfree.fits with the band interpolated across from the local sky on both sides; stack = additionally write <image>_trails_mef.fits (SCI + TRAILMASK extension) for excluding the trail from multi-frame stacks.

params.name: fill-noise
params.label: Add sky noise to interpolated pixels
params.help: Interpolated pixels get Gaussian noise of the sky sigma so that the noise level of the filled image is preserved.

params.name: flag-catalog
params.label: Flag catalogue objects (TRAIL_FLAG)
params.help: Add TRAIL_FLAG (1 footprint touches the mask, 2 centre inside, 4 looks like a trail fragment), TRAIL_ID and TRAIL_DIST to the catalogue.

params.name: touch-k
params.label: Footprint size (x A,B)
params.help: An object touches a trail when its ellipse k x (A,B) reaches the mask band.

params.name: show-overlay
params.label: Show the mask overlay
params.help: Switch the mask overlay on after Remove Trails.

params.name: confirm-panel
params.label: Show the result panel (with Undo)
params.help: Small window with the result and an Undo button.

params.name: show-filled
params.label: Open the interpolated image in a frame
params.help: With fill = interpolate, load <image>_trailfree.fits into a new frame.
